company.name: Docbot
company.shortDescription: Docbot is an AI technology company that offers AI-assisted image analysis solutions to revolutionize gastrointestinal care.
company.description:
Docbot is an artificial intelligence technology company focusing on gastrointestinal (GI) diseases. Docbot’s products are built on the UltivisionAI software platform for real-time image analysis, automated reporting, and analytic tools to improve patient care and clinical workflows. 

Docbot's mission is to provide the most powerful AI-assisted image analysis solutions to revolutionize GI care.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based software application that offers an automated quantitative assessment of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) using endoscopic video.

productsAndServices.description: A real-time detection and differentiation software for precancerous tissue in the esophagus, specifically for non-dysplastic and dysplastic Barrett’s Esophagus.
productsAndServices.name: Veritai

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based software application that provides an automated endoscopic video quality and scoreability assessment for IBD and colon cancer evaluation.
productsAndServices.name: Curai

aiResearchSummary.text: Docbot is researching AI-assisted image analysis for gastrointestinal care, as shown by systems for autonomous and continuously self-improving learning that identify targeted information in large-scale unlabeled data, and methods for aggregating features in video frames to improve tissue abnormality detection. Additionally, they develop systems for enhanced automated endoscopy workflow by integrating patient-specific information into decision processes, covering AI learning, image analysis, and workflow automation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $4,000,000, or 94.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $225,000, representing 5.33% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,191,922 to $19,001,584, a 4.53x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
